svg.title: Edge-Cloud Continuum architecture
svg.desc: Robot and local GPU at the edge, an orchestrator spawning headless O3DE containers in a serverless GPU mesh, and LLM agents plus training in the global AI cluster. Data moves as frames, scenarios, synthetic datasets and weight deltas.
svg.text: Serverless distributed GPU mesh · federated swarms · O3DE · C++17 · Python
Illustrative schematic of the repository architecture. Not a benchmark.
